title: setMinter emits no event (and V2 uses single-step Ownable)
description: setMinter (ATokenDispatcherV2.sol:85) changes a privileged role without emitting an event, hindering off-chain detection. Separately, V2 Ownable is single-step (Ownable2Step would guard a transfer mistake, but reckless-admin mistakes are known-invalid).
attackPath: setMinter (ATokenDispatcherV2.sol:85) changes a privileged role without emitting an event, hindering off-chain detection; V2 Ownable is single-step (Ownable2Step would guard a transfer mistake, but reckless-admin mistakes are known-invalid).
recommendation: Emit an event (e.g. MinterUpdated(oldMinter, newMinter)) in setMinter for monitorability. Optionally adopt Ownable2Step for ownership transfers (minor note; reckless-admin transfer mistakes are otherwise known-invalid).
justification: Missing-event half is a legitimate monitorability QA point independent of owner trust; Ownable2Step half is reckless-admin-adjacent (known-invalid) and folded in as a minor note -> QA.
